scripts.dev: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @stockagent/api" "npm run dev -w @stockagent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run build -w @stockagent/api && npm run build -w @stockagent/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run typecheck -w @stockagent/api && npm run typecheck -w @stockagent/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run test -w @stockagent/api && npm run test -w @stockagent/web
scripts.db:generate: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run db:generate -w @stockagent/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @stockagent/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run db:seed -w @stockagent/api
scripts.backup:tenant: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run backup:tenant -w @stockagent/api --
scripts.migrate:legacy: npm run build -w @stockagent/shared && npm run migrate:legacy -w @stockagent/api --
